os.source: Explicit override or local operating-system observation.
os.purpose: Select path semantics and reject a machine-role profile that does not support the observed OS.

user.source: Explicit override or current local account identity.
user.purpose: Bind path resolution to the actual user profile without committing a real username to tracked fixtures.

onedrive_enabled.source: Explicit override or presence of a local OneDrive root environment value.
onedrive_enabled.purpose: Record whether OneDrive participates in the user profile; this toggle never guesses or rewrites the Desktop location.

desktop_dev_root.source: Explicit override or the operating system's resolved Desktop known-folder plus Dev.
desktop_dev_root.purpose: Authoritative mutable development root for this user, regardless of whether Desktop is local or OneDrive-backed.

proof_states.proves: The configured remote default branch contains the intended commit.
proof_states.does_not_prove: Any local checkout, production/use path, or operator entrypoint is current.

proof_states.proves: The registered canonical development checkout resolves to the intended commit with preserved local work and a successful Git I/O health probe.
proof_states.does_not_prove: The production/use path has been updated.

proof_states.proves: The registered installed/served/field runtime was derived or updated from the intended commit and its owning verification passed.
proof_states.does_not_prove: The real operator entrypoint is observing that runtime.

proof_states.proves: The real registered operator entrypoint resolves the intended production/use path and current identity.
proof_states.does_not_prove: A product deployment or live target outcome succeeded.

profiles.purpose: Normal mutable development and repository maintenance for a resolved Windows user profile.

canonical_development_checkout.purpose: Canonical mutable SysAdminSuite development checkout composed from this user's resolved Desktop Dev root.
canonical_development_checkout.authority: resolved user profile plus developer checkout
canonical_development_checkout.currentness: profile identity plus Git identity plus Git I/O health plus refreshed remote comparison

production_use_path.reason: Development-only profile; product-specific production/use paths are owned by a field or application profile.

temporary_worktree_root.purpose: Collision-isolated branch/worktree execution without creating a second canonical clone.

real_operator_entrypoint.resolution: Select the task's registered command/front door only after user-profile, canonical-path, and freshness proof.

profiles.purpose: Admin workstation development plus sealed field-runtime use for a resolved Windows user profile.

canonical_development_checkout.purpose: Canonical mutable SysAdminSuite development checkout composed from this Admin Box user's resolved Desktop Dev root.
canonical_development_checkout.authority: resolved user profile plus developer checkout
canonical_development_checkout.currentness: profile identity plus Git identity plus Git I/O health plus refreshed remote comparison

production_use_path.purpose: Short sealed AutoLogon field runtime staged by the owning refresh/bootstrap workflow.
production_use_path.currentness: sealed runtime manifest and owning runtime-seal verification

temporary_worktree_root.purpose: Isolated repository work only; never the installed field runtime.

real_operator_entrypoint.resolution: Operator execution routing selects the registered front door and proves the resolved path before execution.

profiles.purpose: Normal mutable development and repository maintenance for a resolved Linux user profile.

canonical_development_checkout.purpose: Canonical mutable SysAdminSuite development checkout composed from this Linux user's resolved Desktop Dev root.
canonical_development_checkout.authority: resolved user profile plus developer checkout
canonical_development_checkout.currentness: profile identity plus Git identity plus Git I/O health plus refreshed remote comparison

production_use_path.reason: Development-only profile; product-specific installed or served runtimes require their own profile authority.

temporary_worktree_root.purpose: Collision-isolated Git worktrees outside the canonical mutable checkout.

real_operator_entrypoint.resolution: Select a registered repository command only after user-profile, canonical-path, and freshness proof.

profiles.purpose: Normal mutable development and repository maintenance for a resolved macOS user profile.

canonical_development_checkout.purpose: Canonical mutable SysAdminSuite development checkout composed from this macOS user's resolved Desktop Dev root.
canonical_development_checkout.authority: resolved user profile plus developer checkout
canonical_development_checkout.currentness: profile identity plus Git identity plus Git I/O health plus refreshed remote comparison

production_use_path.reason: Development-only profile; product-specific installed or served runtimes require their own profile authority.

temporary_worktree_root.purpose: Collision-isolated Git worktrees outside the canonical mutable checkout.

real_operator_entrypoint.resolution: Select a registered repository command only after user-profile, canonical-path, and freshness proof.

operator_command_safety.reason: PowerShell parses separately submitted control flow independently, native command failures do not honor ErrorActionPreference automatically, and a workstation default-branch handoff cannot depend on an artifact that exists only in an unmerged PR.

proof_ceiling: Path and user-profile identity/separation proof only. This registry does not prove repository freshness by itself, does not update a workstation, does not stage a field runtime, and does not prove a live deployment or target outcome.
